items.title: The dimension formula for Cohen-Macaulay morphisms of locally Noetherian schemes
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a morphism f : X -> Y of locally Noetherian schemes that is locally of finite type and Cohen-Macaulay, the local dimension of X at x equals the local dimension of Y at y = f(x) plus the dimension of the fibre X_y at x. The retained proof is written out: after shrinking X around x, the flat-finite-presentation CM-fibres lemma gives a constant d such that every fibre has dimension d at every point, so f is flat, locally of finite type and of relative dimension d, and the dimension formula for maps of relative dimension d (Morphisms, rel-dimension-dimension) concludes. Retained author proof at lines 5857-5866.
